entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The mythic plane of the Theros block, heavily modeled on Greek mythology.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: City modeled after Sparta, centered on a rough and unforgiving warrior lifestyle.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: City modeled after Athens, a more civil and refined society.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: City styled after the Amazones, focusing on female warriors.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God of the Pantheon, reminiscent of Zeus and Helios.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: God of the Pantheon, analogous to Poseidon and Thalassa.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the Pantheon, analogous to Hades and Erebos.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God of the Pantheon, analogous to Prometheus and Hephaestus.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: God of the Pantheon, analogous to Artemis.

entities.name: The Theriad
entities.description: An epic story excerpted in flavor text throughout the block, analogous to the Iliad.

entities.name: Anax
entities.description: Character inspired by Leonidas, king of ancient Sparta.

entities.name: Cymede
entities.description: Character inspired by Gorgo, queen of ancient Sparta; has a vision of the Gods.

entities.name: Brimaz, King of Oreskos
entities.description: A king referencing Leonidas I of Sparta.
